contract: Classification and argv tests only; no downloaded code is executed or installed. External tools/services are not certified or bundled.

records.free_alternative: Read details/events/logs and investigate manually with kubectl.
records.review_note: External model requests may disclose cluster data and may incur provider charges; review scripts and provider terms.

records.free_alternative: Inspect rollout CRDs with the generic browser or kubectl.
records.review_note: PowerShell statements and ReadKey are not literal argv; use reviewed platform-specific scripts.

records.free_alternative: Inspect rollout CRDs; use the separately installed Rollouts CLI for its actions.
records.review_note: Pipelines and shell interpolation need a rewrite; select the actual served Rollout GVR.

records.free_alternative: Browse workflow CRDs and inspect their YAML/events.
records.review_note: CLI authentication/options and installed CRD versions must be verified; shell watch recipes need separate scripts.

records.free_alternative: Browse Application CRDs and review YAML changes with kubectl.
records.review_note: An Argo CD server login is a separate identity; KUBECONFIG does not constrain a server-side argocd app sync.

records.free_alternative: Inspect managedFields in YAML; that is not a full blame history.
records.review_note: External ownership rendering and paging require the external tool.

records.free_alternative: Inspect Carvel CRDs/YAML and use the separately installed Carvel tools.
records.review_note: Shell export/pipes need reviewed scripts; pause/kick change controller state.

records.free_alternative: Inspect Certificate CRDs/events; use cmctl explicitly for renew/inspection.
records.review_note: Secret inspection discloses certificate content; renew changes state.

records.free_alternative: Browse discovered CRDs and inspect/edit their YAML.
records.review_note: Requires an available KIND column and an external TUI; literal argv must replace the shell command.

records.free_alternative: Browse Crossplane CRDs and inspect their status/YAML.
records.review_note: Conditional namespace handling, external watch and group-qualified kinds require reviewed scripts.

records.free_alternative: Use explicit kubectl --kubeconfig/--context flags for each command.
records.review_note: Upstream use-context writes configuration; never run it against the caller configuration. A private config is not a shell sandbox.

records.free_alternative: Use reviewed kubectl debug; built-in shells connect to existing containers only.
records.review_note: Virtual containers scope and POD/NAME meanings differ; privileged debug creation is not a native capability.

records.free_alternative: Inspect declared image references; use dive separately for image layers.
records.review_note: Virtual container selection and IMAGE column are unavailable to root plugin hotkeys; image-layer analysis remains external.

records.free_alternative: Review an exported manifest and apply a deliberately edited copy with kubectl.
records.review_note: Duplication/debug actions create resources; never infer read-only from the missing dangerous flag.

records.free_alternative: Review/export a manifest and create an explicitly named copy with kubectl.
records.review_note: Short resource aliases must become exact GVR scopes; the external extension still needs installation.

records.free_alternative: Inspect nodes and declared resources with kubectl; AWS billing views remain external.
records.review_note: Do not scrape private ExecCredential launchers for AWS_PROFILE/region; configure the external AWS tool explicitly. AWS services may charge.

records.free_alternative: Inspect ExternalSecret/PushSecret CRDs and explicitly annotate with kubectl.
records.review_note: Timestamp command substitution and controller-specific API versions need review; reconciliation changes state.

records.free_alternative: Browse Flux CRDs/YAML and run the installed Flux CLI explicitly.
records.review_note: Toggle/trace scripts perform lookups, conditionals and writes; select the actual served API groups/versions.

records.free_alternative: Browse a selected resource family or enumerate/list with kubectl api-resources.
records.review_note: Loops, suppressed failures and many API calls are not a single native all-resource view; retain explicit scope and errors.

records.free_alternative: Use kubectl api-resources and explicit resource-family listings.
records.review_note: External enumeration and paging require the extension; namespace NAME differs from a resource namespace.

records.free_alternative: Use helm show values or helm get values with explicit release/context.
records.review_note: Virtual Helm rows and release-secret decoding are unsupported; yq dialect and secret handling require review.

records.free_alternative: Use helm history/get values; diff retained manifests with ordinary diff.
records.review_note: Virtual Helm/history rows, revision arithmetic and release-name parsing are not available.

records.free_alternative: Plan a reviewed migration to Helm 3 and use its supported uninstall command.
records.review_note: Legacy Helm 2/Tiller purge is not translated or certified; do not execute the unquoted helper.

records.free_alternative: Use helm get values with explicit release, namespace and kube context.
records.review_note: Virtual Helm rows are unsupported; provide an explicit release input to a separately reviewed definition.

records.free_alternative: Use the built-in reviewed CronJob suspend/resume operation.
records.review_note: Replace boolean inversion with an explicit desired boolean; this is set-state, not a toggle.

records.free_alternative: Use an existing pod shell; review node/container-runtime administration separately.
records.review_note: Virtual container scope, runtime IDs and Docker root access are external and highly privileged.

records.free_alternative: Inspect KEDA CRDs; review an explicit annotation change with kubectl.
records.review_note: overwriteOutput is unsupported; conditional pause mutation needs a separately reviewed script.

dependencies: kube-metrics external tool and its metrics backend
records.free_alternative: Use kubectl top where Metrics Server/RBAC permit; unavailable metrics are not zero.
records.review_note: External metrics aggregation is not native; explicitly pin the tool connection instead of relying on ambient defaults.

records.free_alternative: Review migration to Helm 3 before using helm uninstall.
records.review_note: Executable helper, not YAML. Legacy purge, unquoted substitutions and BSD-only xargs are not supported recipes.

records.free_alternative: Use resource details/YAML or compose an explicit kubectl get argument vector.
records.review_note: Printing shell text is not execution safety; shell conditionals/formatting require a reviewed script.

records.free_alternative: Use kubectl logs with jq explicitly, or bounded native log viewing.
records.review_note: Executable helper, not YAML; replace unquoted arguments and review raw terminal/color output.

dependencies: compatible KubeVirt controller/CRDs and migration permissions
records.free_alternative: Inspect KubeVirt CRDs; run installed virtctl deliberately for migration.
records.review_note: Migration is an external effectful operation; the fixture tests arguments, not a real migration.

records.free_alternative: Use bounded native logs or kubectl logs and a separately installed JSON formatter.
records.review_note: Pipelines and an interactive shell are not automatically translated; service/deployment log selection is external.

records.free_alternative: Use native bounded logs or aggregate logs for active Pods/workloads.
records.review_note: Container pager scope needs an explicit container input; foreground output is outside capture bounds/redaction.

records.free_alternative: Use native log viewing or reviewed kubectl logs piped to jq.
records.review_note: External helper remains required; its original unquoted shell recipe is not bundled.

dependencies: Loki server/credentials and its retained logs
records.free_alternative: Use native current-container logs; those do not replace Loki history/query services.
records.review_note: Loki is a separately configured service/identity. Root-row fixtures test query argv only; container virtual scopes are unavailable.

records.free_alternative: Use native Pod/workload aggregate logs with its documented reader limit.
records.review_note: Quote numeric argv; use an explicit selector input because empty FILTER has no selected-name fallback.

records.free_alternative: Inspect node details/YAML; review node debugging separately.
records.review_note: The pinned script reads $1 without passing a selected host, uses an old image and privileged host namespaces; no automatic translation.

records.free_alternative: Explicitly reveal the intended Secret key, then inspect a certificate with local OpenSSL.
records.review_note: Certificate decoding is external and discloses Secret content; compatible OpenSSL commands need verification.

dependencies: permitted debug image and PVC access
records.free_alternative: Inspect PVC/Pod details and use a reviewed temporary Pod manifest with kubectl.
records.review_note: Resource creation, RWO scheduling, heredocs, waits and cleanup require a reviewed script; not a native debug session.

dependencies: expandable StorageClass/CSI driver and resize permissions
records.free_alternative: Review a PVC storage request change with kubectl; observe actual driver/controller status.
records.review_note: A quantity allowlist replaces free-form JSON interpolation. No real storage expansion is certified by argv fixtures.

records.free_alternative: Use the built-in deliberate finalizer workflow where supported, or a reviewed kubectl patch.
records.review_note: Removing finalizers can bypass cleanup. The fixture is deliberately restricted to apps/v1 Deployments rather than global scope.

records.free_alternative: Inspect requests/limits; use separately configured kubectl top/metrics tools for observations.
records.review_note: Recommendations remain external; the pinned namespace recipe uses RESOURCE_NAME rather than selected NAME and needs correction.

records.free_alternative: Use reviewed ordinary namespace deletion and investigate finalizers first.
records.review_note: Force-finalize is destructive; shell pipelines and missing explicit scope must be rewritten, never run blindly.

records.free_alternative: Inspect scheduled Spark CRDs and explicitly set suspend with kubectl.
records.review_note: Rename the mixed-case command and replace inversion with an explicit desired boolean; verify the served GVR.

dependencies: permitted image and workload create/exec permissions
records.free_alternative: Use an existing container shell or review an explicit temporary Pod manifest.
records.review_note: Embedded manifest creation/exec and cleanup are not a native debug workflow; a reviewed external script is needed.

records.free_alternative: Use reviewed per-workload scaling; record desired replica counts yourself.
records.review_note: Namespace-wide down/up state storage and restoration belong to the external tool, not native scaling.

records.free_alternative: Inspect DNS-related events/logs; perform packet tracing with a separately reviewed diagnostic tool.
records.review_note: Shell arithmetic/variables, virtual container scope and privileged debug Pods require review; no native DNS/eBPF tracing claim.

dependencies: a Vector container with vector executable/API enabled
records.free_alternative: Use native logs; Vector throughput statistics require Vector itself.
records.review_note: Pod recipe can be rewritten as literal exec; virtual-container variant needs an explicit container input.

records.free_alternative: Use native related-event snapshots or the original background example in this guide.
records.review_note: Shell conditional resource-group construction is not copied; the original example deliberately scopes to Pod events.
